newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan detains stock player for manipulation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan detains stock player for manipulation.

text.p: Taiwan prosecutors on Tuesday night detained a stock market player on suspicion of manipulating stocks, the Securities and Exchange Commission said on Wednesday.
"Prosecutors' move on Tuesday was based on our request to crack down on stock market manipulation," a commission spokeswoman said.
Prosecutors had detained Tan Ching-lien, nicknamed "Teacher Tan", a stock analyst on cable television, she said.
Tan, who is not a qualified analyst, has attracted thousands of small investors with his recommendations on which stocks to buy and sell on his television programme, triggering heavy speculation.
Prosecutors are investigating whether Tan was involved with other market players in jointly manipulating stocks, the spokeswoman said.
The commission had asked prosecutors and police to investigate 23 cases of possible stock manipulation or insider trading in 1996, down from 43 cases in 1995, she said.
